ideas.title: Best gear of the year (budget edition)

modeled_on.title: The most innovative music tools of the year

ideas.hook: "These were the music tools that actually changed how I make music this year."
script: Cold open: 5-second sound of each item back-to-back
Ranked list of 6–8 items you own or can try (decks, pedals, plugins, Rekordbox features)
For each: 20s demo, 1 pro, 1 con, price
Finish with your #1 and a call to comment theirs

Play 3 short mixes

Verdict: would you gig with it?
